title: Invention of writing
description: Cuneiform script emerges in Sumer, marking the beginning of recorded history.

title: Old Kingdom Egypt
description: Pyramid age begins with the Third Dynasty of Egypt.

title: Hammurabi's Code
description: One of the earliest written legal codes is established in Babylon.

title: Exodus / Bronze Age collapse
description: Widespread collapse of Bronze Age civilizations across the Eastern Mediterranean.

title: Founding of Rome
description: Traditional date for the founding of Rome by Romulus.

title: Buddha and Confucius
description: Lifetimes of Siddhartha Gautama and Kong Fuzi shape Asian philosophy.

title: Alexander the Great
description: Macedonian conquests spread Hellenistic culture from Greece to India.

title: Punic Wars end
description: Rome destroys Carthage, establishing dominance in the western Mediterranean.

title: Julius Caesar assassinated
description: Death of Caesar triggers the end of the Roman Republic and rise of Empire.

title: Han Dynasty peak
description: Han China reaches its greatest territorial extent under Emperor Wu.

title: Fall of Western Rome
description: Deposition of Romulus Augustulus marks the fall of the Western Roman Empire.

title: Rise of Islam
description: Hijra of Muhammad; founding of the Islamic calendar and rapid expansion.

title: Charlemagne crowned
description: Crowned Emperor of the Romans, founding the Carolingian Empire.

title: Norman Conquest
description: William the Conqueror invades England at the Battle of Hastings.

title: Magna Carta
description: King John of England agrees to limits on royal power.

title: Black Death
description: Bubonic plague sweeps through Eurasia, killing an estimated third of Europe.

title: Fall of Constantinople
description: Ottoman capture of Constantinople ends the Byzantine Empire.

title: Columbus reaches Americas
description: Christopher Columbus lands in the Bahamas, opening sustained European contact.

title: French Revolution
description: Storming of the Bastille begins a decade of radical political upheaval in France.

title: Industrial Revolution
description: Steam power and mechanized manufacturing transform economies globally.

title: World War I ends
description: Armistice ends the first global industrial war.

title: World War II ends
description: Axis powers surrender; nuclear age begins; UN is founded.

title: Fall of Berlin Wall
description: The Berlin Wall falls, symbolizing the end of the Cold War in Europe.
